label: M1_mode5_super_lucky
_note: Mode 5 = 高阶幸运模式. Mode 2's next tier up.

Design brief (user 2026-04-22): RTP ~500% while keeping mode 2's ~27.76% hit rate. Shift bucket distribution TOWARD higher multipliers — player sees more 机台特征 events (wild-sevens, 3-Diamond combos) without dropping the base hit cadence.

Math: same hit rate × 2x more RTP → per-hit average multiplier doubles (mode 2 avg 10.5×, mode 5 avg 18×). Push mass out of the 1-10× low-bucket band into the 50-500× high-bucket band. Mid (10-50×) stays similar in absolute pp but shrinks as share of the bigger RTP total.
ge50_lt100 (wild-amplified):   1.5%   → 105pp   (21%) ← 机台特征 sweet spot

Feature density: the 50-500× hits occur at combined 3.1% rate = 1 in 32 spins. Compared to mode 2's 1 in 72 spins, mode 5 delivers 'feature wins' more than twice as often. This matches the 'super-lucky' brief — it's not just more RTP, it's more peak moments.
CV projected ~ 5.8 (vs mode 2's 5.5). Marginal increase — variance goes up with more high-tier hits but the floor of constant Cherry/Bar still dampens it.
Strips are SHARED with mode 1/2/7 (file layout invariant). Only weights differ.

per_reel_symbol_targets.name: wild_family
per_reel_symbol_targets._rationale: Triple Diamond-style uniform distribution — every reel ~10% wild. 'Every reel is hot' feel fits super-lucky brief. 3-wild jackpot reachable from any combo. Aristocrat Dragon Link base / IGT Triple Diamond 1993 prototype.

per_reel_symbol_targets.name: seven_family
per_reel_symbol_targets._rationale: Super-lucky mode: Seven uniformly ~20% per reel — 'every reel is hot' for Sevens too. Produces real mode 5's 2.78% Seven family hit rate (5× mode 1). Without this constraint the tuner pareto'd Seven to 1.2% (vs real 2.78%).
